Hi Priya,

Quick one — our CFO just got pulled into an investor prep call that overlaps with the 11:00am ET walkthrough we had scheduled for Wednesday. Lina and I still want to see the Redwood exec-friendly overview, but we have only 30 minutes available during that slot now.

Options that would work on our side:
- Compress the walkthrough to a 25–30 minute executive summary that focuses on cost/latency impact + customer examples, OR
- Keep the 45m live slot and have you share a short recording of the exec overview now and a separate deeper technical session with SEs next week.

Can you confirm whether you can do a compressed 30m session (with follow-up tech deep-dive), or if we should accept a recording and schedule the technical session separately?

Thanks — sorry for the late heads-up.

Simon — thanks for flagging and totally understand. Looping in Karthik (SE) and Monica (your AE) so we can propose an approach. Three viable paths from our side:

1) Condensed 30-minute exec walkthrough today: we keep it high-level (value props, perf/cost bullets, 2 quick customer examples) and save technical Q&A for a follow-up. Karthik will attend to answer 1–2 quick technical clarifications.

2) Keep the 45-minute live slot but replace the exec portion with a pre-recorded 12-minute exec overview we can send immediately; follow with a technical deep-dive with the SE next week (30–60m).

3) Cancel today and rebook: full product + technical runbook next week (tight availability window).

I've attached a suggested 30m agenda and an updated mutual action plan reflecting the split-run approach. If you confirm option 1, we can shorten slides and focus on the KPIs you care about.

Proposed condensed agenda (30m):
- 0–5m: Quick intros & goals (we'll call out cost/latency SLOs)
- 5–15m: Exec product highlights + customer ROI examples
- 15–25m: High-level architecture + security/compliance bullets
- 25–30m: Next steps + follow-up technical deep-dive scheduling

Simon — what do you prefer? If option 1, please confirm the new time (keeping the calendar event) and we will remove 15–20 slides to fit.

Thanks,

Priya Natarajan

Thanks for the context — quick technical note from SE side: compressing to 30m is feasible if we limit live demo time. Proposal: skip the live 15-min token-by-token demo and instead show a 3-min pre-recorded demo clip (latency, throughput, cost per 1k tokens) and spend the live time on architecture and integration patterns. That reduces live time risk and gives execs a concrete example.

If we go live for 30m, my recommended slide edits (I can do these overnight):
- Remove deep integration examples (slides 18–24)
- Keep 2 customer ROI slides and the KV-cache + batching slide
- Add one slide with recommended runtime configs for Orchid's expected workload

Availability note: I'm on-call Wed afternoon but can be on the call at 11:00am ET for a 30m condensed walkthrough. If you want the deeper technical session, I'm available next Tues 14:00–16:00 ET or Thurs 09:00–11:30 ET.

If you prefer to send the pre-recording now, I can prepare a short 3-minute demo clip and a 10-slide tech appendix for the follow-up.

—Karthik
